content: {"episode_id":"ep-05059","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of symptomatic atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
